# SCRUM-77 static anchor learning log

These are source-based contrast diagnostics, not browser/axe acceptance or proof of a continuously compliant living theme. No clock, scheduler, interpolation runtime or living-theme menu option is implemented. Teetotaler remains the initial/default theme. BEDLAM, local artwork themes, construction artwork and fixed black/yellow tape remain independent.

The mathematical audit samples 1,001 equally spaced sRGB channel interpolation states per adjacent drink pair. Pairings cover inherited prose/links/footer/grid, secondary/status text, navigation, button normal/hover/active/selected states, native input/select colors, kiosk body/screen and meaningful borders. New-palette disabled buttons retain opacity 1; Teetotaler retains its accepted opacity 0.6. Two-tone focus rings provide a contrasting ring on light and dark adjacent surfaces. Native disabled file-control chrome, ridge-border bevels, shadows, clipping and actual browser rendering require human/browser inspection; decorative dividers/shadows are not claimed as meaningful UI boundaries. Dense samples are diagnostics, not a mathematical guarantee between samples.

## Tequila Sunrise - sunrise

Yellow illuminated page, orange/coral section and navigation surfaces, deep red-brown text/controls. Minimum tested text 7.031:1 (secondary text on section); UI 6.106:1 (grid border on section). Body text and inherited links remain well separated from the warm surfaces.

This first palette exposed missing kiosk/system-color, input, grid, divider and disabled-alpha roles. Shared tokens now cover them. Baseline Canvas/CanvasText/Field/FieldText, currentColor, fixed grid grays and footer divider are preserved exactly. New themes add explicit native light/dark chrome and a two-tone focus ring without recoloring artwork. Teetotaler parity assertions passed. No transition to an unimplemented next anchor is claimed.

Validation: focused 27/27; Angular 224/224; Node 158/158; production build passed (297.55 kB initial, estimated transfer 80.22 kB); formatting/whitespace passed. Existing jsdom canvas warnings remain. Browser surfaces unavailable; no visual, axe or Lighthouse claim.

Next: Mojito (bright daytime), then Piña Colada, then Mai Tai (golden hour). No ordering change recommended yet. Evaluate sunset/night polarity before extending the safe corridor.

### Dusk boundary: POLARITY CROSSOVER / unsafe direct interpolation

Tequila Sunset -> Rum Runner: body minimum 1.002:1 at t=0.454; minimum text 1.000:1 at t=0.448; minimum UI 1.000:1 at t=0.571. At 0.001 sampling increments, the first failing state is t=0.066 and the last failing state is t=0.856 across the tested pairings; outgoing sampled safe corridor ends at 0.065 and incoming begins at 0.857. These fractions describe a hypothetical straight sRGB path, not clock times or approved hop locations. Do not render that path.

Recommendation: controlled atomic hop from the completed Sunset endpoint to the completed Rum Runner endpoint. Immediately before: minimum text 5.809:1 and UI 5.030:1. Immediately after: text 8.614:1 and UI 6.053:1. Switch the whole semantic bundle together: page/prose, secondary/status, navigation, control normal/hover/active/selected foregrounds and surfaces, panel/kiosk/input surfaces and foregrounds, borders, native color scheme. Focus rings remain fixed. No CSS transitions on these global colors were added; current static selection already switches by root attribute. Future engine must not interpolate across this boundary.

Surfaces cannot safely be claimed to continue smoothly with only the two existing body foregrounds jumping: outgoing foreground luminance 0.02125 requires surface luminance >=0.27061 at 4.5:1; incoming foreground luminance 0.88908 requires surface <=0.15868. There is no shared admissible surface interval. A surface/foreground coupled hop is the smallest safe recommendation; bridge colors or other staged paths would need separate design and validation. Any wholly continuous inversion must cross equal foreground/background luminance, so reordering alone cannot remove the underlying polarity problem. No reorder recommended merely to hide it.

Next: Bloody Mary, pre-dawn dark polarity; analyze its same-polarity path and the return to Sunrise. No living runtime implemented.

Browser/axe/Lighthouse acceptance not run.

### Dawn boundary: POLARITY CROSSOVER / unsafe direct interpolation

Bloody Mary -> Tequila Sunrise: body minimum 1.001:1 at t=0.499; text 1.000:1 at t=0.498; UI 1.001:1 at t=0.470. First failing sampled state t=0.110, last t=0.882; outgoing sampled safe corridor ends at 0.109 and incoming begins at 0.883. Diagnostic fractions are not approved clock times or hop thresholds.

Recommend a second atomic semantic-bundle hop at dawn, from the pre-dawn endpoint to Sunrise. Immediately before: minimum text 7.171:1 and UI 5.907:1. Immediately after: text 7.031:1 and UI 6.106:1. Same coupled roles as dusk; native color scheme changes to light, focus rings remain fixed. Current body foregrounds again have no common safe surface interval: outgoing requires surface luminance <=0.15719; incoming requires >=0.26536. A foreground-only hop over a smoothly changing surface is not proven safe; the smallest supported remedy is the coupled endpoint hop. No living runtime added.

Recommended order remains Sunrise -> Mojito -> Piña Colada -> Mai Tai -> Sunset -> Rum Runner -> Bloody Mary -> Sunrise. No MARGINAL or unexplained UNSAFE same-polarity regions were found in this sample model. The two inversion boundaries require controlled hops with these endpoints; clock speed cannot rescue their unsafe intervals. Reordering is not proposed as a substitute for resolving inversion.

Final available navigation: Teetotaler, Tequila Sunrise, Mojito, Piña Colada, Mai Tai, Tequila Sunset, Rum Runner, Bloody Mary. No unavailable theme entries, living mode, scheduler, animation or interpolation runtime. Teetotaler exact-value parity remains green. The remaining decision is human acceptance of static visual identity and the documented future two-hop strategy; dense sampling is not a continuous proof or WCAG certification. Remaining browser coverage includes desktop/mobile/zoom, menu overflow, disabled native file chrome, focus-ring clipping, dark-surface BEDLAM recognition, representative Home/case-study/Perspective/footer surfaces and axe.

Stopped because the authorized, sufficiently defined Sunrise-to-Sunrise static anchor sequence is complete. Further themes would expand this run; the living engine is explicitly excluded. Next action is human browser/axe review and committee review of the dusk/dawn hops before any living-theme implementation. Other previously discussed drinks are not silently added as anchors.
